audit_log_tamper_evident.title: Audit Log Tamper-Evident
audit_log_tamper_evident.description: Audit trail integrity-protected/tamper-evident — append-only/WORM (AU-9(1)), hash-chain/signing (AU-9(3)), change-detection alerting, log access monitored; fires is_false (mutable, clearable without trace).

file_integrity_monitoring_enabled.title: File Integrity Monitoring Enabled
file_integrity_monitoring_enabled.description: FIM/change-detection on the log store alerts on any modification/deletion of existing records; fires is_false.

logs_stored_on_separate_system.title: Logs Stored On Separate System
logs_stored_on_separate_system.description: Audit records replicated to a physically different system than the audited host (AU-9(2)) so host compromise can't erase the only copy; fires is_false.

centralized_log_aggregation.title: Centralized Log Aggregation
centralized_log_aggregation.description: Log collection/retention centralized off-host (SIEM/aggregation tier) near-real-time; fires is_false (siloed per-host).

least_privilege_access_enforced.title: Least-Privilege Access Enforced
least_privilege_access_enforced.description: Read/management access to the audit store restricted to need-to-know least-privilege and periodically reviewed; fires is_false (broadly accessible). Absorbs read-access restriction (PCI 10.5.1).

audit_management_restricted_to_privilege.title: Audit Management Restricted To Privileged Subset
audit_management_restricted_to_privilege.description: Access to audit/logging MANAGEMENT (configure/modify/delete records + pipeline) limited to a privileged subset; fires is_false. NIST AU-9(4).

log_access_monitored.title: Log Access Monitored
log_access_monitored.description: All access to the logs is itself recorded and monitored (audit-of-the-audit); fires is_false. PCI 10.2.3; AU-9 alerting.

security_events_fully_logged.title: Security Events Fully Logged
security_events_fully_logged.description: Full set of security-relevant event classes captured (auth success/fail, authz failures, privileged actions, account/auth changes, audit-log access, audit start/stop/pause, object create/delete); fires is_false. PCI 10.2; NIST AU-2/AU-12.

required_record_fields_complete.title: Required Record Fields Complete
required_record_fields_complete.description: Each record carries the fields to reconstruct an event (what/when/where/source/outcome/identity); fires is_false. NIST AU-3; PCI 10.3; CIS 8.5.

clocks_synced_to_trusted_time_source.title: Clocks Synced To Trusted Time Source
clocks_synced_to_trusted_time_source.description: System clocks generating timestamps synced to a trusted UTC/atomic source (approved NTP); fires is_false (free-running/manipulated). NIST AU-8; PCI 10.6; CIS 8.4.

timestamps_in_utc.title: Timestamps In UTC
timestamps_in_utc.description: Timestamps recorded in/normalizable to UTC so multi-source records collapse to one timeline; fires is_false. NIST AU-8.

time_source_access_restricted.title: Time Source Access Restricted
time_source_access_restricted.description: Access to time data restricted and time-setting changes controlled+logged; fires is_false. PCI 10.6.3.

log_retention_days.title: Log Retention Days
log_retention_days.description: Days audit-log history retained before rotation/aging. Fires lt 365 (PCI 10.7 12-month floor; CIS 8.10 floors 90). Short retention destroys evidence.

log_storage_sized_for_retention.title: Log Storage Sized For Retention
log_storage_sized_for_retention.description: Storage sized to hold the full retention window without premature rotation/overwrite; fires is_false. CIS 8.3; NIST AU-4.

log_flood_overflow_protection.title: Log Flood Overflow Protection
log_flood_overflow_protection.description: Pipeline resists adversary log-flooding forcing rotation/overwrite (rate limits/quotas, headroom, overflow alerting); fires is_false.

tls_only_transport.title: TLS-Only Transport
tls_only_transport.description: Log records forwarded exclusively over encrypted+authenticated transport (syslog-over-TLS), never cleartext; fires is_false. OWASP Logging.

encrypted_at_rest.title: Encrypted At Rest
encrypted_at_rest.description: Log store + archives encrypted at rest with strong managed-key crypto; fires is_false (plaintext store readable). NIST 800-92; AU-9(3).

pii_excluded_from_logs.title: PII Excluded From Logs
pii_excluded_from_logs.description: Sensitive PII/payment/secrets/tokens/session-ids excluded or masked from records; fires is_false (confidentiality breach + credential-harvest target). OWASP Logging.

secrets_masked_in_logs.title: Secrets Masked In Logs
secrets_masked_in_logs.description: Masking/redaction at log-emission redacts any secret/token reaching the logging path; fires is_false. (Secondary to pii_excluded_from_logs.)

logging_failure_alerting_enabled.title: Logging Failure Alerting Enabled
logging_failure_alerting_enabled.description: Stop/pause/reconfigure/silent-failure of the logging pipeline raises an alert; fires is_false. PCI 10.2.6; NIST AU-9/AU-5.

log_review_cadence_defined.title: Log Review Cadence Defined
log_review_cadence_defined.description: Collected logs reviewed on a defined enforced cadence so tampering/gaps/IoCs are detected; fires is_false (collected-but-unreviewed). PCI 10.6; CIS 8.11; NIST AU-6.
